_meta.description: Reviewed security baseline for sumrae412/claude-skills. Each suppressed finding has been manually classified. Do NOT add new entries without a reason field and PR review. 'self-match-false-positive' = the scanner's own pattern strings / documented threat examples. 'documented-pattern-example' = skill documents an attack for educational purposes. 'tooling-fp' = scanner or test tooling legitimately uses the flagged construct. 'bounded-tempfile-op' = file operation on a bounded tempfile within known scope.
_meta.t6_rebaseline_note: T6 PRs #128 (docs) + #131 (scanner) landed. 21 new suppressions added (self-match FPs, documented-pattern-examples, tooling FPs, bounded-tempfile-ops). 1 genuine finding NOT suppressed: inbox-triage::T6-LETHAL-TRIFECTA::SKILL.md::62 — true positive per PR #131 commit body. Needs Summer review.

worth-review/accepted: base64.b64decode() is used to decode GitHub API responses — the GitHub Contents API returns file content as base64. Reviewed: the decoded bytes are immediately passed to .decode('utf-8') and stored as a string dict value; they are never eval'd, exec'd, or written to a file. The decode target is a GitHub-API response for doc files (KEY_DOC_PATTERNS match). Not an obfuscation mechanism. Human review confirms: accepted as legitimate API usage.
